      <h4 class="dl-note-title">Windows C++ Redistributable</h4>
      <p class="dl-note-body">OpenSpace requires the <a href="https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe">Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2022</a>. A copy is included in the downloaded folder. If you see "VCRUNTIME140_1.dll was not found," install it to resolve the error.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="dl-note">
      <h4 class="dl-note-title">Network access</h4>
      <p class="dl-note-body">OpenSpace will request internet access on first launch &mdash; a standard Windows security prompt. Granting permission is required for full functionality, including the user interface and live data features.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="dl-note">
      <h4 class="dl-note-title">Updating from a previous version</h4>
      <p class="dl-note-body">Use the <a href="https://data.openspaceproject.com/release/0.21.3/OpenSpace-0.21.3-minimal.zip">lightweight download</a> if you're updating an existing installation. Copy your <code>sync</code> and <code>user</code> folders from the previous version into the new OpenSpace directory.</p>
    </div>
